intro: Ke modiri wa dithulaganyo yo o simololang. Ke tsamaisa tirelo ya go amogela diseva ASHIKA Network le lenaane la diseva tsa Minecraft SABALISU, mme ke dira thulaganyo ya seva ya Minecraft Storia.
about: Ke sa ntse ke le mošwa, mme ke kwala khoutu letsatsi le letsatsi e bile ke a tokafala
Ke tsamaisa tirelo ya me ya go amogela diseva
Dipotso ka ga ditirelo tsa me kgotsa thekenoloji di a amogelwa: ntumedise fela mo Discord
can_write: Se ke kgonang go se kwala (go akaretsa khoutu e e sa rulaganngwang)
anw_t: ASHIKA Network: diseva go simolola ka yen e le 30 ka kgwedi
anw_p:
Tirelo ya go amogela mo go ba ba batlang go tsamaisa seva mme ba sa kgone go dirisa madi a mantsi.
Simolola ka bonnye, **go simolola ka yen e le 30 fela ka kgwedi**.
sab_t: SABALISU: lenaane la diseva tsa Minecraft
sab_p:
Tsenya seva ya gago ya Minecraft mo lenaaneng mme o bone batho ba ba tla tshamekang mo go yone.
E thusa babatshameki ba ba batlang seva le beng ba ba batlang go itsise ya bone.
storia_t: Storia: thulaganyo ya seva ya diseva tse dikgolo tsa Minecraft
storia_p: Fork ya motswedi o o bulegileng ya Folia ya Minecraft 26.2. Ka **Storia Cluster**, lefatshe le le lengwe le ka dira mo disebeng di le mmalwa ka nako e le nngwe, mme batshameki ba fudugela magareng ga tsone kwa ntle ga sekirini sa go laela.
storia_points: **Storia Cluster**: lefatshe le le lengwe le le abelanwang ke diseva di le mmalwa, ka dikgolagano tse di fitlhegileng
**Relay ya polokelo**: relay ya bobedi e boloka khopi e e tshelang mme e tsaya maemo a ya ntlha fa e latlhegile
**Popego ya Linear**: lefatshe le tsaya bontlha jwa lefelo mo diskeng
**Lefatshe mo RAM**, **Tick Guard**, API ya plugin ya data e e abelanwang, le go feta
welcome: Sengwe le sengwe se a amogelwa!
